Internal evaluation notes for Yardline CI:
- (5/5) Yardline CI cache hit rate matched an independent re-run study at 78% on a flaky monorepo fixture.

doc_b.text:
Internal evaluation notes for Kiln Pipelines:
- (5/5) Kiln Pipelines remote cache documented byte-identical outputs across two OS images in a vendor whitepaper.
- (4/5) Step timing charts attribute wait time to queue vs execution, useful for capacity planning.
- (3/5) Self-hosted runners auto-drain before AMI rotation.
- (2/5) YAML linter blocks unpinned actions in pull requests.
